hardware.method: Three rotated comparisons of four routes over equal 15-file inputs per cohort. Each group compares verified readback and complete compacted image size. The diagnostic uses modeled idle opportunities and real runtime device admission. Complete time includes route discovery where applicable, maintenance, and compacted CPU verification.

earlier_attempts.reason: The WinFsp fixture initially lacked the codec header for typed result inspection.

scope: Controlled synthetic and public-derived groups on one physical Windows AMD device. All publication and CPU readback paths use the protected indexed format. Timings are workload-specific and automatic GPU preference remains unqualified.
